items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Harry Fleming who was a famous dancer, who I knew, he had come over with Belle Davis' Pickaninnys to

ctx.x: Eight months after. Well, in any case from then on we accepted this contract with Mr. Lehmann which was a bona fide contract. It didn't pay much, but we were satisfied, and we went sightseeing and everything else.

We doubled in -- he had a garden, another establishment, which he called the Taxim Gardens. He had the Petite Chaut. And the Taxim Gardens was further out, I'd say it's about two or three kilometers out from Constantinople.
